title: A Phase III Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Petrelintide in Participants with Overweight or Obesity and Type 2 Diabetes
official: A PHASE III, RANDOMIZED, DOUBLE-BLIND, PLACEBO-CONTROLLED, PARALLEL GROUP STUDY TO EVALUATE THE EFFICACY AND SAFETY OF ONCE WEEKLY PETRELINTIDE VS. PLACEBO IN PARTICIPANTS WITH OVERWEIGHT OR OBESITY AND TYPE 2 DIABETES
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the efficacy of petrelintide compared with placebo on change in body weight
conditions: Overweight or Obesity and Type 2 Diabetes (T2D)
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Ability and willingness to comply with all aspects of the protocol including completion of all procedures, study visits, questionnaires, assessments for the duration of the study
2. Age ≥18 years at the time of signing Informed Consent Form
3. Body Mass Index (BMI) ≥ 27.0 kg/m2
4. Have a history of at least one self-reported unsuccessful dietary effort to lose body weight
Exclusion criteria:
1. Current or previous treatment with petrelintide or any other amylin analog
